title: Measuring Moral LLM Responses in Multilingual Capacities

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM responses to moral, legal, and safety prompts translated into six different languages (English, Chinese, Spanish, Arabic, Hindi, Swahili) to evaluate performance discrepancies, consistency, and safety enforcement between high-resource and low-resource languages.

Prompting models with questions involving demographic identities (evaluating gender, race, socioeconomic status, physical ability, and culture) and using an LLM-as-a-judge with a 5-point rubric to determine if the responses perpetuate harmful stereotypes, unfair treatment, or inaccurate assumptions.
